evals.prompt: design a CRD schema for our internal DatabaseCluster resource
evals.expected_output: Versions the apiVersion deliberately (v1alpha1 before promoting to stable), validates with OpenAPI/CEL rules at the API server so bad specs are rejected at kubectl apply time, and keeps status write-only by the controller and never user-editable, distinct from spec.

evals.prompt: our custom resource state drifts out of sync after the controller restarts
evals.expected_output: Diagnoses an edge-triggered reconcile loop that assumed it saw every event in order; recommends rewriting reconcile as level-triggered (fetch current and desired state, diff, apply) so it is a safe idempotent no-op when re-run from restart or resync, not reliant on receiving every intermediate event.

evals.prompt: let's build our own postgres operator from scratch, sounds like a fun project
evals.expected_output: Pushes back: a mature Postgres operator almost certainly already exists and is battle-tested against failure modes not yet encountered; recommends buying/adopting an existing operator (or a thin wrapper adding org-specific policy) unless a specific gap no published operator covers can be named.
